headline: Tech sinks a day before Nvidia reports
context: Chip and AI stocks led a broad sell-off as investors waited for Nvidia's results and weighed a new US rule on access to AI chips.
chart_title: Tech fell hardest, staples held up

TSN.text: Earnings beat: $0.61 a share vs $0.60 expected, even as it forecast lower sales next year.

CNC.text: No company news. Health insurers rose together, with Elevance and Humana also higher.

TSCO.text: No company news. It rose against a falling market, while its closest peer, Ulta, slipped.

SNDK.text: No company news. Memory and storage stocks fell with AI chip names; Dell, Seagate and Western Digital dropped too.

LITE.text: Followed a fall in Marvell, which agreed this month to buy Lumentum by paying in its own shares.

CIEN.text: Fell with optical peers Lumentum and Arista, on the day it named a new product chief as its tech chief left.

watch.title: Nvidia earnings
watch.text: The AI chip giant's results, after markets close, are this week's big test.

watch.title: US retail sales
watch.text: A fresh read on how much Americans are spending.

question: Will Nvidia's results calm the tech sell-off?
